rationale: FAST gapped down ~7.6% on earnings, then recovered nearly the entire gap, now sitting at 91.4% of today's range and within pennies of the session high ($52.42) on 5x relative volume — a massive intraday reversal that has largely played out. The stock is pressing against today's high with momentum stalling (last 5 candles show a slight fade from 52.08 to 52.02), making a long entry near the high risky with only 0.84% to resistance, while a short against a strong recovery trend with broad market weakness already partially absorbed is equally unattractive. With today's realized P&L already negative and the setup offering no clean asymmetric entry in either direction, skipping preserves capital.
